statusLine.command: input=$(cat); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); printf "\033[2m%s@%s:%s" "$(whoami)" "$(hostname -s)" "$(basename "$current_dir")"; if [ -d "$current_dir/.git" ]; then cd "$current_dir" && git_branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'detached'); printf " (%s)" "$git_branch"; fi; printf " [%s]\033[0m" "$model"
